blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu may not experience a sharp drop in temperatures as the northeast monsoon, or Amihan, officially begins. The state weather bureau is expecting only limited immediate changes in the province’s weather despite cooler conditions elsewhere in the country. Engr. Al Quiblat, chief of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) Visayas, said Cebu residents should expect occasional light to moderate rain and localized thunderstorms as other weather systems continue to influence the region.
